text: Good evening. I'm looking after my grandson tonight while his parents are away, he's 6. I took his temperature about twenty minutes ago and it was 37.7. Earlier on I noticed a rash across his tummy and the tops of his arms, sort of pinky red blotches. I remembered something about pressing a glass on it, so I did that with one of the kitchen tumblers. The marks went pale under the glass every time, all of them, then came back pink once I took it away. I tried it in four or five different places to be sure. He's in bed now. I'm not one to panic, but I'd rather check with someone who knows than guess, and I'll have to explain it all to his mother in the morning. Is there anything I should be keeping an eye on overnight, or is it a case of seeing how he is when he wakes up?
